blocks.html:
It's a Wonderful Night for Oscar!

OSCARS 2019

The Awards up for grabs tonight:

THE BIG FIVE
(Correctly choose Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, and Best Screenplay, Original or Adapted.)
-

EXECUTIVE PRODUCER
(Most wins overall.)
ERNIE

KEY GRIP
(2nd place still gets you an award. Nice!)
ALTHEA
JAMI
RITA

Grand Auteur
(Sole winner in a single category.)
ERNIE - VISUAL EFFECTS
MATTEO - BEST DIRECTOR
MATTEO - BEST PICTURE

IT'S AN HONOR TO BE NOMINATED
(2nd to last place.)
HARRY
MARCY

THE ALAN SMITHEE AWARD
(Last place. Formerly 'Best Loser'.)
TIM
Reminder: Refresh this page after every award for the latest updates!
Right-click to open this post in a new window and comment throughout the show.

(Sole winner in a single Category)
